entry.title: Boomerang: Bitcoin Cold Storage with Built-In Coercion Resistance
entry.summary:
The email primarily focuses on the technical aspects of a device and system redundancies in a project. The java card, referred to as "Boomlet" in the protocol, is identified as the sole critical component within the setup. Currently, a backup for the Boomlet exists, but an activation mechanism for this backup has not been designed yet. This highlights a potential area for further development in ensuring the robustness of the system.
Additionally, there are plans to enhance the reliability of other components, specifically the watchtower (WT) and Search and Rescue (SAR) functionalities. The proposed improvements include adding multiple instances of WTs and SARs to create redundancy, thereby increasing the system's overall fault tolerance.
The correspondence also acknowledges the suggestion of incorporating a recovery checklist into the ancillaries list, which indicates a proactive approach towards comprehensive system management and disaster recovery preparedness. This inclusion could significantly contribute to more organized and efficient handling of potential issues in the future.
